title: account_cash_rounding — invoice cash rounding L3 (Thai-relevant)

module_location.note: No standalone account_cash_rounding addons directory. Logic embedded in account module.

fields.rounding: Float, precision step, default 0.01, must be > 0

methods.round: account_cash_rounding.py:51 — wraps float_round with configured precision and method
methods.compute_difference: account_cash_rounding.py:59 — currency.round(amount) then self.round(amount)-amount then currency.round(diff)

invoice_integration.form_view_gating: account_move_views.xml:1555 — visible only with group, read-only after draft
invoice_integration.onchange_warning: account_move.py:2768 — warns if add_invoice_line strategy and no profit_account_id

rounding_line_lifecycle._recompute_cash_rounding_lines: account_move.py:3076 — orchestrator, called from _sync_rounding_lines context manager at 3248
rounding_line_lifecycle._compute_cash_rounding_inner: account_move.py:3090 — inner function: calls compute_difference, converts balance if multi-currency
rounding_line_lifecycle._apply_cash_rounding_inner: account_move.py:3104 — inner function: builds rounding_line_vals, branches on strategy
rounding_line_lifecycle.display_type: account_move_line.py:339 — 'rounding' is a named selection value
rounding_line_lifecycle.create_or_update: account_move.py:3154-3158 — write() if existing, create() otherwise
rounding_line_lifecycle.removal_conditions: no invoice_cash_rounding_id, or diff is zero, or strategy changed

add_invoice_line.account_selection: loss_account_id if diff_balance > 0 (rounding up), else profit_account_id
add_invoice_line.tax_ids: Command.clear() — no taxes on the line
add_invoice_line.th_suitability: PREFERRED — creates visible line on Thai tax invoice

biggest_tax.account_selection: account_id of the tax line with highest abs(balance)
biggest_tax.tax_attributes: copies tax_repartition_line_id, tax_tag_ids, tax_ids from that tax line
biggest_tax.th_suitability: POSSIBLE — adjusts VAT silently; less transparent for Thai RD invoices

fiscal_position_interaction.pointer: account_cash_rounding.py (full file) — no fiscal_position field or reference
fiscal_position_interaction.note: Fiscal positions cannot remap the rounding account. Accounts are configured per-company on the rounding record.

payment_reconciliation.payment_model_cash_rounding: ABSENT — account_payment.py has no cash_rounding reference

payment_term_integration.note: _compute_terms() accepts cash_rounding parameter and applies compute_difference() to each instalment's foreign amount; payment term lines are cash-rounded for consistency with invoice total

payment_reconciliation.amount_total_includes_rounding: Yes — _compute_amount() at account_move.py:1196-1224 includes rounding line in total

thai_billing_analysis.whole_baht_rounding_feasibility: CONFIRMED — set rounding=1.00 in account.cash.rounding record
thai_billing_analysis.recommended_strategy: add_invoice_line — visible separate line on invoice
thai_billing_analysis.accounts_required: profit_account_id and loss_account_id must be mapped to Thai chart of accounts
thai_billing_analysis.feature_activation: Enable Cash Rounding in Accounting > Settings
thai_billing_analysis.thb_decimal_context: THB has 2 decimal digits standard but Thai invoices round to whole baht; rounding=1.00 achieves this regardless of currency rounding precision
